elements.el: Undo line
elements.reason: one inline run after the icon: "Undo: the act" for an act with an inverse, "No undo: " with nothing bold for one without (the card draws only acts with an inverse)

elements.el: Expiry
Retry's Undo, "Cancel the 3 new runs"
elements.reason: a retry keeps the job's attempts (BullMQ keeps them when a failed job is retried), so the cancel of a queued job, which takes only a job that never started, can never take it back; the preview says so instead

elements.el: Bulk results, one line per job, Reload primary
Audit rows 41 to 43
elements.reason: said as how many rows and the first, linked to it, never a range: the audit writer locks per row, so another session's row can land between a bulk confirm's own and a range from the first to the last would name it

elements.el: Refused at preview: field rule (`BadRequest`), whole action, missing deps (:1317), preview failed (:1325)
Every refusal ends "nothing was changed"
elements.reason: every refusal that comes before anything was written; one that can follow a write (the kill switch reached some queues, a bulk apply threw part-way) is REFUSAL_STATES.partial, which says PARTIAL_NOTE instead and offers Look again, a state the card does not draw

elements.el: Field errors inline under the field (field--err)
elements.reason: PR 2 says a field's refusal in the slot's body, which names the field and the rule; an error under the field comes with each page's converted forms (PR 7a for Configuration's)
